decisions.reason: A flanged dismantling joint fits the firm's core pipeline-component range and costs little to keep listed, and one year on the market reveals too little about its value to justify abandoning the option.

The ceiling or floor pipe bracket has its own product page, is a simple fabricated item made with existing welding and coating capability, and needs little upkeep, so management keeps the option open while demand from infrastructure projects becomes clear.
The pipe support bracket complements the firm's fittings and custom fabrication business at low holding cost, and its uncertain early prospects favour keeping rather than dropping it.
